name: Algolia
description: Algolia is an AI-powered search and discovery API platform providing "one AI retrieval platform" for agentic, generative, and traditional search, recommendations, and personalization experiences.
best_for: Ecommerce, B2B commerce, media, SaaS, and higher-education organizations seeking to improve product discovery, conversions, and user engagement through AI-powered search, serving 18,000+ customers across 150+ countries.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 10,000 search requests/month, 50,000 records, 5,000 recommendation requests/month. No credit card required.

tiers.name: Grow
tiers.notes: Pay-as-you-go with no flat base fee. Includes 10,000 requests and 100,000 records free, then $0.50 per 1,000 requests and $0.40 per 1,000 records. Monthly self-serve billing, no contract.

tiers.name: Grow Plus
tiers.notes: Same free allowance as Grow, but the overage rate jumps to $1.75 per 1,000 requests (3.5x Grow's rate) in exchange for AI ranking, advanced personalization, and query categorization. Monthly, no contract.

tiers.name: Elevate
tiers.notes: Contact-sales only, requires an annual contract. Volume-based discounted custom pricing; adds real-time personalization and a 99.99% availability SLA.

cons: Grow Plus's overage rate for search requests is $1.75 per 1,000 versus $0.50 on plain Grow, a 3.5x price jump just to unlock AI ranking and personalization features.
No flat or predictable monthly fee exists on Grow or Grow Plus — both are pure consumption billing per request and per record, making costs variable rather than a fixed subscription.

Top-tier features such as real-time personalization and a 99.99% SLA require the Elevate plan, which is contact-sales-only and requires an annual contract — there is no self-serve path to enterprise-grade SLA.
features: AI Search with AI-driven ranking and retrieval
Recommendations engine using behavioral data to increase engagement
Personalization tailored to individual user journeys
Browse for curated category pages and guided shopping
Agent Studio for creating, testing, and deploying AI agents
MCP Server enabling search within agentic workflows

alternatives.name: Elastic
alternatives.description: The company behind Elasticsearch, a distributed search and analytics engine with AI-enabled search, observability, and security solutions.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a self-managed or cloud search/analytics engine with deep customization and observability tooling.

alternatives.name: Supabase
alternatives.description: An open-source backend platform built on Postgres, offering built-in full-text search alongside database, auth, and storage APIs.
alternatives.best_for: Developers wanting basic search built into their existing Postgres backend rather than a dedicated search service.
